end.line: Quillon for Northgate Logistics’ legal team

vo: Northgate Logistics’ legal team supports twelve hundred carrier contracts, and liability limits differ by mode of transport.
Your liability positions for road, sea and air are remembered in the playbook, each one approved by counsel.
When operations emails a claims question in the morning, Quillon drafts the reply in Outlook from the contract.
Ask what a carrier owes for a damaged shipment, and Quillon answers across the whole contract set.
Viktor will walk your team through it on Thursday the twenty-sixth.
